change: The trimming routine (a hook that fires after each trim), a step-count hook at 15, 30, 45, a short harness question and a requirement-sentence matcher, and a conditional verbatim re-injection of the task text; no change to tools, step cap, or the system prompt body.
target: failure link, model limits (runs that fail with a correct restatement are model-limited)
